layers.name: Chart

prints.shape: met + why (low entered band). No buy / sit / size / exit.

layers.owns: AD T/B/L, met band, met stays met, base_land_warn

rules.text: The AD is the high-to-low this chart keeps recreating, then bouncing enough to sell. One length, this TF, this price range. Kenneth 2026-09-01 locked this.

Kenneth 2026-09-07 full-history-first (locked): Every Chart walk starts from listing (or the earliest official bars on this venue for that name), then walks forward. Do not open on the current swing area or a mid-range start date. Measure bigger dumps across the whole available history first. Then filter to the length that still meets and bounces in the price area price is swinging in. Current range is the filter …

Kenneth 2026-09-07 Chart base-land warning (locked): Every Chart walk names major bases/supports in the window as zones. Omit = FAIL the walk (missing facts), not FAIL the AD. An AD lands on a base when projected B sits in or against that named base zone — general area with wiggle, not a precise tick (same estimate standard as the AD). When that happens, mark base_land_warn on the play. It is a warning weigh, not …
Owns: AD T/B/L, met band, met stays met, base_land_warn
Does not own: Buy / sit / size / exit prices

layers.name: Path

wait + why not tagged (row only; no tape line).

layers.does_not_own: Volume / grind wait (Size); met band (Chart); habit_ready / red habit match

rules.text: Path buys when print tags a hung AD buy layer (print ≤ empty/next AD-role layer) or board-wide panic. Size owns live volume and grind wait.
Kenneth 2026-09-07 Path RECUT (locked). Delete: habit_ready and red-count / faster-TF habit match as buy gates. Delete: habit_ready false sit that blocks buys at the AD.

layers.name: Size

prints.when: Path bought; Size waits at AD / board grind

layers.owns: Which buy layers fill, real-volume gate, grind wait, AD-side scale, panic shares; optional 5m vol weigh
layers.does_not_own: Met-band definition; Path tag / panic buy gate

rules.text: Kenneth 2026-09-07 base_land_warn Size pointer: when Chart marks base_land_warn, stay conservative (smaller size) until the warn lifts or another clean AD is preferred — detail in Chart; not a Fail rewrite.

AD-side prices use dump depth D = L / T. The standing rule is (Kenneth 2026-09-01, across the board): start_pct = clip(70 + 30×D, 78, 95). end_pct = clip(98 + 5×D, 97.5, 100.8). If D ≥ 0.50, end_pct = max(end_pct, 100.3). If high_magnet (this same AD already has copy_count ≥ 2, or a prior volume tag of this same AD — never by ticker name), start_pct = max(start_pct, 93) and end_pct = max(end_pct, 99.6). Default hi…

Board-wide grind extra sentences (Kenneth 2026-09-03): these run only when most watched coins (stocks out) are slow and board-wide panic is not on. How the list is counted lives in the Board-wide grind file, not here. Mixed tape, a sideways board, or too few names: these sentences stay off. One name grinding its last red into its own AD is this chart, not the list. When they are on: react to the live dump plus vol…

Panic prices: Q_i = B − B × (0.10 + 0.18 × (i−1)/2) for i = 1, 2, 3 (10 / 19 / 28% of B under B). Kenneth 2026-09-04 recut. Do not use L in panic depth. Old Q_i = B − L × (0.10 + 0.18 × (i−1)/2) is deleted. Do not put Q1 slightly under B. Q1 must sit clearly below P5. Breaking the AD is usually add, not flatten. That half is where this process earns.
Owns: Which buy layers fill, real-volume gate, grind wait, AD-side scale, panic shares; optional 5m vol weigh
Does not own: Met-band definition; Path tag / panic buy gate

layers.name: Fail

prints.shape: add-panic + why Fail — current price broke AD; add panic half. Path sit must not block.

layers.owns: Break of AD → add panic half (not flatten); grind fail / short-copy fail

rules.text: Owns: Break of AD → add panic half (not flatten); grind fail / short-copy fail
Does not own: Path tag buy; Size volume

layers.name: Exit

prints.shape: paper-sell + layer why or into named base.
exit-live + adapt reasons. Named unmet base clips bounce map high.

layers.owns: Sell layers adapt, into-base, leftover, sideways-too-long when Reed number exists

rules.text: Exits are TF dependent. Exit layers sit toward the typical bounce on the chosen TF: how far a finished AD bounce on that TF usually runs, from official bars. If this TF has no repeating bounce, do not invent one. The Machine does not guess a target. Kenneth 2026-09-04 exit hang correction: Master does not wait for Kenneth to name that chart’s sell prices first. Reed writes bounce, base, and candles-to-bounce from …

Kenneth 2026-09-07 Exit gate workflow (locked): Reed exit facts not ready without bounce + unmet bases above B (zones + role) + candles-to-bounce; Gauge clips map high to nearest unmet big base above B inside/below the bounce map before placing layers; Lock FAILs any sell pack that misses bases, puts map high through a named base without a sell into it, wrong TF layer count, or parks at bottom — bounce-legal alone…

Sideways too long is not a clock. Reed writes this TF’s bounce habit: how many candles after an AD tag a real bounce usually starts. If current price is at the AD, those candles have passed, and there is no bounce like this chart usually prints, that is sideways too long. Then consider an exit. If this TF has no repeating start time, do not use this line. The Machine does not flatten on it until Kenneth recuts tha…
Owns: Sell layers adapt, into-base, leftover, sideways-too-long when Reed number exists
Does not own: Entry buy gates

rules.text: Kenneth 2026-09-10 H1 hang gate (locked): Met-band = B through B + 0.05×L. Before hang, Lock checks AD-side buy layers vs that band. Lock FAILs a hang if AD-side layers are not acceptably in/near the met-band approach — do not hang a broken set; Gauge fixes first. If only P1 is above the met-band high and P2–P5 are correct, Lock FAIL or warn on P1 and do not hang until P1 is fixed. This is Lock before hang, not Si…
